rows: - 15 Nov, doctests in the Rust unit stage (issue #83 section 2; test type: unit, a lib crate's `cargo test --doc` inside its `cargo-unit` target, n=1, commit `42cca5b`, green run 43693607344 on `5510388`). The doctest of `wf_kit::time::iso` runs in 0.39 s locally; the unit shards took 109 to 213 s against 95 to 132 s on the run before (43690328314), but that run replayed most crates from the cache and this one rebuilt every dependant of `wf-kit`, so the shard times do not isolate the added stage; the added work is one doctest binary per lib crate that has a runnable fence. Decision: keep it, a crate gets the stage when a runnable fence (rust, no_run, should_panic, compile_fail, edition) appears in its lib doc comments.
